candidate: IREN Sweetwater 1 data-centre campus, FM 611, southern Fisher County (Sweetwater mailing area), Texas
decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the six Fisher County parcels whose owner of record is IE US DEVELOPMENT HOLDINGS 5 INC (TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels, Fisher Appraisal District, tax year 2026): 3770 (N/2 Sec 178, 320 ac), 3524 (S/pt Sec 179, 392 ac), 33142 (E/2 Sec 212, 207.29 ac), 4262 (E/2 Sec 212 3 H&TC, 102.22 ac), 33160 (W/2 Sec 209 3 H&TC, 176.549 ac) and 1958 (W/2 Sec 209 3 H&TC, 107.016 legal / 70.5 GIS ac). The union has two parts separated only by an 18-22 m strip along which TIGER/Line FM 611 runs (the road right-of-way), so the property straddles FM 611. The centroid lies inside the larger western part, 133 m from its boundary. It locates the IREN Sweetwater 1 landholding (campus) as recorded in the 2026 roll, not a building, the bulk substation or the construction extent.
precision_scope: Centroid of a 1,265-geodesic-acre (1,305 legal acres) six-parcel landholding straddling FM 611, about 4.56 km east-west by 2.94 km north-south; vertices lie up to 2.76 km from the point. TCEQ's 'Data Center Phase 1 - Early Works Package' regulated entity is described on the east side of FM 611 about half a mile north of CR 448, which falls on parcel 33160, about 1.25 km east of the point.
horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: Appraisal-district parcels carry no published positional accuracy; the centroid represents a 1,265-acre landholding whose data-centre buildings and substation are not separately located by any captured official source.

computed.crs: Served EPSG:4326 (wkid 4326); union and centroid computed in EPSG:3083 (NAD83 / Texas Centric Albers Equal Area) with pyproj 3.7.1 and shapely 2.1.1 and transformed back; areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid (pyproj Geod). A UTM 14N (EPSG:32614) recomputation gives the same centroid within 0.02 m.

road_context.note: US Census TIGERweb local roads: FM 611 runs within 4-12 m of five of the six parcels (in the gap between the two parts); Co Rd 448 meets FM 611 at the south-east corner of the property.

completeness: Identify requests without geometry over five tiles from -100.72 to -100.32 and 32.48 to 32.76 (Fisher, Nolan and Scurry appraisal-district parcels, tax year 2026) found no other parcel owned by IE US Development Holdings 5 Inc; the six parcels total 1,305 legal acres against the 1,700 acres IREN states for Sweetwater 1, so part of the stated site may be held otherwise or acquired after the roll date.
identity_bridge: Five of the six parcels give the owner's mailing address as 620 FM 1033, Childress, TX 79201, the address of TCEQ regulated entity RN112177357 (OSSF 620 FM 1033, principal IE US Development Holdings 3 Inc, industry 518210 data processing and hosting) at IREN's Childress campus; parcel 4262 gives 6/55 Market St, Sydney NSW 2000, matching the 'Suite 2, Level 6, 55 Market Street, Sydney' organization address in IREN's own iren.com structured data.
personal_data: Only company owners are named. Names of private individuals returned by the parcel requests are not copied.
